```artifact
Feature: Software Engineering Process Coordination

  Scenario: Coordination of Activities
    Given the Software Engineering process is initiated
    When the team is guided by Prof. Chandrasekaran and other esteemed staff of NITK Computer Science & Engineering Department
    Then all activities are coordinated

  Scenario: Quality Medicines via Authorized Chemists
    Given the Hospital has decided to provide quality medicines
    When the patient purchases medicines from authorized Chemists within the zone
    Then the medicines are provided at discounted prices

  Scenario: Door-step Laboratory Services
    Given the Hospital has decided to provide door-step Laboratory services
    When the patient requests specimen collection
    Then the specimen is collected at the patient's doorstep

  Scenario Outline: Specimen Collection
    Given the Hospital has decided to provide door-step Laboratory services
    When the patient requests specimen collection with <specimen_type>
    Then the <specimen_type> is collected at the patient's doorstep

    Examples:
      | specimen_type    |
      | Blood Sample     |
      | Urine Sample     |
      | Invalid Specimen |

  Scenario Outline: Authorized Chemists
    Given the Hospital has decided to provide quality medicines via authorized Chemists
    When the patient purchases medicines from <chemist_name> within the zone
    Then the medicines are provided at discounted prices

    Examples:
      | chemist_name    |
      | XYZ Chemist     |
      | ABC Chemist     |
      | Invalid Chemist |
```
